purpose: SpeakRight Desktop visible en-US/es-ES/fr-FR/ru-RU phoneme-practice IPA audit input for conservative expert review

confirmedPolicy.global: Audit only currently visible phoneme-practice entries; hidden rule units stay out of this corpus.
confirmedPolicy.english: Keep the existing General American chart/course convention and only fix clear spelling-to-IPA mismatches.
confirmedPolicy.spanish: es-ES stays phoneme-first for ordinary word rows; allophone symbols are reserved for explicit allophone or implementation units.
confirmedPolicy.french: Use dictionary-style IPA for words; phrase and sentence rows may show connected-speech realization when that is what learners should say.
confirmedPolicy.russian: Stress, reduction, hard/soft consonants, final devoicing, and voicing assimilation must stay visible when they affect the learner-facing reading.
